title: Cage n(3,20): a 3-regular graph of girth 20 with few vertices
statement: Find a 3-regular simple graph whose girth (shortest cycle) is at least 20, with as few vertices n as possible; it shows n(3,20) <= n (cages grow with the girth). The best known (k,g)-graph in the House of Graphs cage table has 5376 vertices [Ex20]; a graph with fewer vertices improves it.
submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as House of Graphs gives them; an optional >>graph6<< or >>sparse6<< header is allowed), or an edge list, one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0.
score: n, the number of vertices of a 3-regular graph of girth at least 20 (smaller is better)

best_known.source: n(3,20) <= 5376: [Ex20] in the House of Graphs cage table (houseofgraphs.org/meta-directory/cages; J. Goedgebeur, J. Jooken, T. Van den Eede); read 8 Nov 2026
